verses.gurmukhi: ਚਰਣ ਕਵਲ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਖ ਆਏ।
verses.translit_en: charan kaval saranaagatee saadhasa(n)gat mil gur sikh aae|

en.bdb: In the holy congregation, the disciples of the Guru come in the shelter of the holy feet of the Guru.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਦਿਸਟਿ ਨਿਹਾਲੁ ਕਰਿ ਦਿਬ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਦੇ ਪੈਰੀ ਪਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: a(n)mirat dhisaT nihaal kar dhib dhirasaT dhe pairee paae|

en.bdb: The nectar like sight of the Guru has blest one and all and due to his divine look, the Guru has put them all at the holy feet (shelter) i.e. they all have been made humble.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚਰਣ ਰੇਣੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਤਿਲਕ ਭਰਮ ਕਰਮ ਦਾ ਲੇਖੁ ਮਿਟਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: charan ren masatak tilak bharam karam dhaa lekh miTaae|

en.bdb: The Sikhs applied the dust of the feet to their forehead and now their account of delusive actions has been erased.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚਰਣੋਦਕੁ ਲੈ ਆਚਮਨੁ ਹੳਮੈ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਰੋਗੁ ਗਵਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: charanodhak lai aachaman humai dhubidhaa rog gavaae|

en.bdb: After drinking the nectar of feet, their maladies of ego and duality have been cured.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪੈਰੀਂ ਪੈ ਪਾ ਖਾਕੁ ਹੋਇ ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਸਹਜ ਘਰਿ ਆਏ।
verses.translit_en: pairee(n) pai paa khaak hoi jeevan mukat sahaj ghar aae|

en.bdb: Falling at the feet, becoming the dust of feet and adopting the way of liberated ones in life they have established themselves in equipoise.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚਰਣ ਕਵਲ ਵਿਚਿ ਭਵਰ ਹੋਇ ਸੁਖ ਸੰਪਦ ਮਕਰੰਦਿ ਲੁਭਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: charan kaval vich bhavar hoi sukh sa(n)padh makara(n)dh lubhaae|

en.bdb: Now having become the black bees of the lotus feet, they are enjoying the nectar of pleasure and delight.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪੂਜ ਮੂਲ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਚਰਣ ਦੁਤੀਆ ਨਾਸਤਿ ਲਵੈ ਨ ਲਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: pooj mool satigur charan dhuteeaa naasat lavai na laae|

en.bdb: The base of worship with them are the lotus feet of the true Guru and they do not allow duality to come near them now.
The pleasure fruit of the gurmukhs is the shelter of the Guru.
